title: Uber: A Ride at a Tap
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Uber: A Ride at a Tap.

hook.text: Travis Kalanick couldn't find a cab in Paris. He decided to fix the problem with an app.

buildup.text: Uber let anyone request a ride from their phone. A driver appeared in minutes.

discovery.text: GPS, mobile payments, and ratings made the experience seamless and trustworthy.

twist.text: Taxi industries worldwide protested and sued. Uber operated in legal gray zones for years.

climax.text: Uber proved that a web-connected app could replace a century-old transportation system.

punchline.text: An app replaced a century of taxi dispatching.

quiz.question: What traditional industry did Uber disrupt?
